You're absolutely right—many people experience a confidence boost when dressed formally, and there's actually a psychological phenomenon called **"enclothed cognition"** ( studied by researchers like Adam Galinsky) that explains how clothing can influence our mindset. It’s like a subtle psychological " uniform of competence" that primes your brain to feel more capable, focused, and self-assured.
